units:
The sound of battle
seems so far away...

It seems I cannot
follow my king into
the final battle.
I have no use for it now.

This spear has slain
many foes, making a
mountain of corpses...
...Do I see tears in your eyes?

Please, do not cry...@w(12)
Your older sister will leave
the world as a great warrior.

Griselda...@w(6) I won't let
you be alone for long.
I shall be by your side soon enough.

There are simply
too many enemies.
So that is the Shadow Knight!

Rumor has it he's made a
deal with Halja to acquire such
strength.@w(12) What power...

How long do you intend to
keep me pinned down?

This battle is over.@w(12)
Any more deaths will
just be a waste...

Oh, I'm glad to see you're safe.@w(12)
I had feared you were—

@s(3)@M(1)But... what good are troops@w(6)
that have lost their leader?
I have an announcement, Your Majesty.

The foes had more 
reinforcements than
we had anticipated.

We were forced to enter
a battle of attrition.

Griselda fought bravely
for you to the very end.

She entrusted me with this
spear in her final moments.

She was the most gallant and
noble of all my warriors...

That spear is a special
weapon known as a Psypher.

It collects spirits that haunt
battlefields and uses their
power to smite enemies.

Henceforth, you shall wield
the spear as you please...

@s(3)We shall launch another
assault on the enemy.

Is that all you have to
say about Griselda!?

Words will not bring
your sister back.

That dastardly queen of
the Fairies...@w(6) She was the one
who summoned the dragon.

Griselda's dead
because she rushed ahead
of the main forces.

It's certainly not because
I was late to the battle.

He may be one of
our nation's heroes...

But I hear he acts as he
wishes because my father
does nothing to stop him.

That spear is a magical
weapon called a Psypher.

The Dwarves fashion the
crystals out of jewels and
use them in the weapons.

It uses magical elements
called Phozons and is able to
absorb and release them.

It will surely lead
you to victory.

That stone on your spear's a
jewel from the Netherworld.
Did you know that?

Traveling from this world
to the Netherworld...

It's very dangerous,
and only one man is able
to do it—King Odin.

If we can obtain that
Cauldron and fabricate
our own jewels...

Ragnanival will have
no more enemies.

We shall regroup with those
able to fight. At the moment
I have four soldiers ready.

We only have half the troops
we started with... Everyone
is rushing to their deaths.

I had heard that the
Shadow Knight looked
like a demon, but...
Why did he let you go...?

I am worried about you...
Please stay strong.

I shall bring some tea
up to your room later.

I'm a traveling vendor
who has been allowed
to sell in this castle.

So you're going to
battle@w(6) in order to win
your father's love...
I'm fighting for my kingdom and my own pride.

I may fall in battle,
but that is a fate all
our countrymen face.

...Don't try to hide
the truth from me.

You seek death, so that
you may earn the love you
so desperately seek...

"I am pathetic. I've
never been loved since
the day I was born."

Giving your life for your
father will not make your
death worthwhile.
You will simply die, like Griselda died.

If I sacrifice myself for
my duty, Father will surely
show his love for me.

this base is under our
control, but the enemy is
stronger than we expected.

I am here to report
that Lord Brigan's troops
shall soon arrive.

The general has sent us a
message to fight strongly.

He's so late...
What is he doing?

Abandon the base
and assault the enemy
with all our troops.

Hurry. Send the order
to attack to all the units.

I could charge extra since
this is a battlefield.

But it's very dangerous. I
could have nine lives, and
it still wouldn't be enough.
Uh... I'll make you a deal.

In this bloodstained land,
the stakes are high, but
the profits are higher.

@M(1)The Aesir have launched
an all-out assault.

Odin... I see he risks his own
life with this strategy of his...

Quickly! Call back the
troops from the front line
and attack them from behind.

Our king is bestowed
with divine grace.

Prepare yourself,
Queen of the Ghosts.

I,@w(6) King Odin's daughter
Gwendolyn, shall be the one
to take your life.
So, you call me a ghost...
The Demon Lord's daughter is bold, indeed.

It seems that my
reinforcements have arrived.

Your Majesty, my
sincerest apologies
for my tardiness.
Let us put this to the test.

Do you still dare to
speak so impudently before
my mighty dragon?

King Odin, please rejoice.@w(12)
The enemies are retreating.
It seems that it is finally over.

Have Brigan's troops
hunt down any remaining
enemy forces.

Go inform all our soldiers
of our victory.

Sound the horn@w(12) and allow
them to celebrate our glory.
The Fairies have kept it hidden for so long...
Do you see this mysterious light?

This power will grant me
victory in any battle...
O-Oh no... What happened to the glow?
The Cauldron's light has gone out.

The king is with the
Crystallization Cauldron.

These stupid battles, all
over again...@w(12) The Cauldron
is a source of disaster.
@M(1)Nor by the queen of the Fairies.

That technology is
so advanced, we can't
make it work.

That witch from the
forest must have put the
Cauldron's fire out.

How did the witch
stop the Cauldron?

If I'd known, I wouldn't
have let her go.

That witch is a refugee
from a fallen enemy nation.

It's the king's fault
she's still alive.

Please refrain from making
such critical remarks in
front of the soldiers.

@s(3)I cannot still my tongue
in the face of weakness.

@M(1)I would rather die fighting
than be subservient...

Valkyries that cannot fight
are wed to brave warriors
to bear brave children.

They are stripped of their
pride and honor and live
under a man's thumb...
He killed many of our troops.

I heard that he pledged his
soul to Death and traded his
life for demonic powers.

All I know is that I
hope I never meet him
on the battlefield.

If that horrible Cauldron
never existed, then this
bloodshed would not happen.

My father is never
wrong in his tactics.

You won the war, right?
Why is everyone so gloomy?

I thought I could make
a profit if you were
all celebrating...

@M(1)@s(3)If she plays dumb,
her head will fly.

Someone stop that
fool before he leaves.

No, he cannot be serious
about opposing me.

I shall find the witch.@w(6)
Gwendolyn, I leave the rest to you.

A king cannot idly
abandon his own castle.

If I had not let the
witch go, this would not
have happened.

Allow me to redeem myself.@w(6)
I shall capture the witch.

You may be a famous Valkyrie,
but you still get hungry out
on the battlefield, right?

Just don't ask where my
wares came from, heehee...
I will not let you escape this time.
You'll never get your wish, Valkyrie.

Confront me all you want, but
you cannot change my resolve.
Go back and inform the Demon Lord.
I will not listen to your pleas.
You have no choice in the matter.

If you insist that you will
not repair the Cauldron...
That evil spear and my chain are both Psyphers.
If we battle, it will be a serious affair.

Bluffing will only get
you so far. If you value
your life, obey the king.

You ignorant fool. You
cut short your own life by
meddling in my affairs.

Using the Crystallization
Cauldron will doom
the entire world.
That accursed Cauldron served as a trigger

to the horror that
befell my native country
of Valentine...

The great magical country
of Valentine is said to have
been destroyed overnight...

I am aware of the story
that you describe...

The Valentine Prophecies
say the world will be
destroyed by five disasters.

One of those five involves a
furnace that spews despair.

You say that line refers to
the Crystallization Cauldron?

'Tis but a rumor@w(6)
from a ruined land.
War will spread across the world...
The winning country will rule over the entire land.

Your country's ambition@w(6)
is merely a convenient lie
for the Demon Lord.

Do you imply that my king
is deceiving everyone?@w(6)@M(1)
I will not hear this mockery.
I shall take your life if I must...

I had a premonition
of something like this,
so I came here.
I cannot allow you to hurt one another.

Do not interrupt
what I have to say...

You look so much
like your mother...

My dear daughter...
Why are you acting
against me?
Do not call me your daughter.
Do you think I am a fool?

While the nations of
Valentine and Ragnanival
were at war,

you disguised yourself and
seduced my mother, the
princess, with sweet words.

And you were quick to flee
when she became pregnant.

Because my mother gave
birth to an enemy's child, she
was executed for loving you.

It is the same as if you
had killed her yourself.
That is not true, my child...

We did not know each other's
real names nor our ranks.

I did not run away from her.@w(6)
@M(1)We were torn apart.

@M(1)If you loved my mother, who
is this other daughter here?

I do not think of you as
my father, and I have no
desire to help you.

I followed the king and
stumbled into a royal spat.

Fraternizing with the enemy.
Who could've guessed...?

Although their demise
was sudden, Valentine
was still our enemy.

the king had an affair
with their princess, and
even had a child.

The subjects will
be most upset.

But as I am a loyal servant
of my king, I will carry
this secret to my grave...
But that Cauldron is another story.
You will help us gain its might.
How did you stop the magic furnace?

There must be some
type of "key" to it.
Speak, Witch, if you value your life.

Even if I told you, there is
nothing you could do.

The Cauldron may
only be controlled by
a ring named Titrel.

A terrible dragon holds
the ring presently.

Wagner, feared by all, keeps
the ring within his stomach.

My lord, what do you
plan for the girl who has
harmed our country so?

If we cannot use the
Cauldron's magic,

shall be a recreation of the
awful war against Valentine.

How are we to inform the
soldiers and the citizens!?

We must sacrifice her
flesh to the dragon and
retrieve the ring!
Command me to sacrifice the witch!
Hm... I sense my king is not content.

Is there any reason to
protect this witch?

Is there anything at all
between our king and his
daughter from an enemy land?
I have heard about the ring.

Wagner is a terrifying
dragon that King Odin once
fought but could not kill.

If even the king could not
defeat it, what can we do?

...That witch. The king
let her live, yet she repays
his kindness with evil.

Princess Griselda died to
gain the Cauldron, and now
her death is meaningless.

Lord Brigan shall surely
administer punishment.

Just a short time ago, he
took the witch and headed
to Horn Mountain.

in order to stand victorious
and help us conquer the
entire continent.

Princess Gwendolyn,
are you feeling ill?

Buy some medicine to keep
you warm before you go.

Is she someone special
to you, Father?

She resembles the
princess I once loved...
I do not wish you to see me like this.

My mother and
sister devoted their
lives to the king...

I never heard him devote
so many words of affection
to me... ever.

...If you leave her,
she will be executed.

That will make you the king's
only surviving daughter.
You will no longer have to compete for his love.

Are you saying you will
save her? This girl who
 cares nothing for you?

...If you do, you are
committing treason. You will
no longer be welcome here.
Will you persist in this folly?
There will be no way to redeem yourself...

How can you willingly choose to
walk the path to your own death...?

I thought I got away from
the goblins, and now I meet
the Demon Lord's daughter.

If you're not gonna kill me,
buy something, will ya?

Heehee... You look like
you might die up here.

It'll be a bit expensive,
but I'll sell you something
if you want.
We haven't found the dragon yet...

Is Wagner really here
as this girl says he is?
I don't mind that he isn't here.
I never wanted to meet the dragon anyway.

Even if you are sacrificed,
there's no guarantee it
will give me the ring.

I'd be needlessly putting
my life in jeopardy.
What are you planning to do?
This is what I will tell your father:

The dragon killed you
here@w(12) as I commanded.
@M(1)If you still wish to live, go!
You've done a very foolish thing.

This isn't about using
the Cauldron,@w(6) is it?

Why do you seek her
death so fervently?
Do you really want to know?

I will inform the nation
that the witch was
 the king's daughter.

And after having a child
with the enemy, he was such
a monster that he killed her.

The people will wonder if
such a man is fit to be king...

I never thought one of my
king's trusted generals
could be so treacherous.

After I deal with you,
I'll recapture that girl and
offer her to the dragon.
Why don't you try begging for mercy?

Perhaps you could be the
new king's mistress, hm?
You have disobeyed me and killed my chief vassal.

The fact that you are my daughter
cannot save you from punishment.
The citizens of the nation will never stand for it.
...There is no excuse for what I did.
I am prepared to face the consequences.

I shall endure any
form of punishment.

you will undergo the
customary punishment.

A sleeping spell will
be cast upon you.

When you awaken, your heart
will belong to a stranger.

Your pride and honor
will be stripped away.

You will devote your life
to him, bear his children,
and grow old.
My actions spared you from suffering.

You are most certainly
my precious daughter...

I... I have longed to hear
you say those words.
I am no longer a Valkyrie.
It's as if it was all a dream...
I feel like I slept forever.
I shall bring you some tea.

I feel a bit better,
knowing that you're here.

I will attend to you, even
if I wasn't ordered to.

That's my spear...
What is it doing here?

Hmm... He said that Odin
gave him that spear.

Princess, you are the
king's daughter, correct?

...To give away the
spear my sister handed
me as she lay dying...

So I have been forced to
accept the enemy's elite
soldier as my husband...
It seems I am destined to suffer...
I must take my leave soon.
I would like to give you something.

I'm sorry; I have nothing
else worthy of being
presented to you...

This is a beautiful ring
that I obtained from a
dragon named Wagner.

Why are you giving me
something so precious?
Hmmm... How can I say it...?

I want to see you smile.
To see you happy.

My only happiness
stems from battle.

When I think about all
the warriors he has slain...

I cannot forgive him, no
matter how kind he is to me.

My father's spell is
making me feel this way.

I shall seek vengeance the
moment it presents itself.
That is what my father would want me to do...

There is no reason for you
to remain loyal to a king
who has abandoned you.

I just want to do what will
make my father happy.

That is what Oswald
just said to you.

He yearns for your love
in the same way you yearn
for your father's.

For now, I am simply a
prisoner being manipulated
by my captor.
I have an oath to keep.

Gwendolyn...
Will you wait for me?

If you command me
to wait, I shall obey.

...And I will not allow
anyone to treat you thus.

This will allow the
Cauldron to be activated.
I must take it to my father...
I come with a message for the king...

I may have been
banished, but I will not
tolerate such treatment.

The king has ordered us
to kill you on sight.
I come with a message for the king...

I may have been
banished, but I will not
tolerate such treatment.

The king has ordered us
to kill you on sight.

This place is suspicious.
I'm thinking of leaving...

You seem to be an honest
soul. I'll sell you something
since you're here.

I'm just a traveling
salesman passing through.

As long as you have cash,
I don't care who you are.

The queen of the Underworld
thinks highly of me.

I have been delegated to
discipline King Odin, who
steals jewels from her realm.

The pitiful king is merely
a puppet to my will.@w(6)
This country is finally mine.

So you're behind the
chaos in this land.

I have violated your
edict, but I have important
information for you.

I was right to
tempt Oswald.

He and I formed a pact:
I would give you to him if he
could slay the dragon Wagner.

The ring is a prize
from that battle...

With your latest actions,
you have atoned for your
past transgressions.

He fought the dragon...
for me...

This is no longer
where I belong.

I wish you and
the heavens well...

You're so irresponsible.@w(12)
You didn't say where you
went. I was nervous.

If anything happened to you,
he'd be very distressed.

It seems like he's
the only thing on
your mind lately.

But he does seem
to be rather late...

There's a very nice
restaurant through
this portal.

Please tell me...@w(6)
Where has he gone?

He went to the Fire Kingdom
to fulfill a promise he made
to the king there.

He's been gone for some
time now.@w(6) Something may
 have happened...
What is happening in the Fire Kingdom?

I cannot bear it...@w(12)
I cannot wait like this.

The Great King Onyx
is just ahead.
It has been awhile, Your Majesty.
You are as beautiful as ever.

'Tis always a pleasure to
welcome you to our kingdom.

This way, please.@w(6)
Allow us to entertain you.

I have come here
seeking answers.

I have heard that my
husband Oswald has
come to this land.

As much as I would like
to say that I am not,

I cannot lie in the
face of such beauty.
Yes. Against a dragon that is terrorizing our country.

Some say that this dragon is Leventhan, the one
mentioned in the prophecies concerning the world's end.

Our fire and our swords
have had no effect on
this newborn dragon.

I thought his Belderiver
may have some effect...

But since I have heard
no news,@w(6)  I assume it was
useless as well...

but King Odin had already
promised your hand...@w(6) to me.

It would've helped unify
both our countries.

But your father went
back on his word...

and instead, gave you
to that tortured soul.

In compensation for letting
the issue drop quietly,
Oswald made me a promise.

He vowed to fight for his life
on my behalf whenever I asked.
He may even already be dead.

I can void our agreement
and save him... if you
will be my bride.
as long as you become mine.

Inferno King, you are
no different than the
men back home...
My heart aches with each passing day...

Heehee... It's quite
rare to see a human
in this area.

It'll be a bit expensive,
but I'll sell you something
if you want.

Oh no, you found me!
...Wait, you're human.

Look, don't tell anyone
that I'm hiding here.

It seems the Queen of the Dead
has reduced my sword's power...

To be defeated by a
newborn dragon like this...

They must be attended
to immediately...

...See what his pride has
cost him. Leave him be.

You have been banished for
disgracing your country, but
you are still astonishing.

To be able to defeat the
dragon from the prophecies,
you intrigue me even more.

Oswald has fought
for you, and the dragon
has been defeated.
We are returning to the castle.

That man has been selected
by the Queen of the Dead...

He will eventually die
as her servant. His very
existence is torment.

Leave that doomed soul,
and take my hand.

Your Majesty, if you persist
in insulting my husband, my
spear will take your hand.

If you do not want
your life extinguished,
get out of my sight!

I shall pay my respects
to such intensity and
back down for now.
Let us leave it at that.

you are the one that stokes
the embers of my heart...

Oswald is safe...@w(6)
What a relief...

Don't go anywhere
without telling me
ever again.

But in any event, I
too am happy to hear
of Oswald's return.

I'm glad that your
husband is safe, Princess.

He is resting
at the moment.

I have heard rumors suggesting
that Oswald has some type of
connection to the Queen of Death.

In order to increase my
Belderiver's power,@w(12) my
father sold me to her.

And just as he wished, I
acquired the cursed power
of the Shadow Knight.

But in compensation for
this contract, the Halja
lurk about everywhere.
They are waiting for the moment my power fades.

As long as I have the Belderiver,
the Halja fear me and stay away.

But this power continues
to be my curse...
That was a close call back there. I must thank you.

But, Gwendolyn...@w(6)
Why did you go to
the Fire Kingdom?
What did you discuss with Onyx?

I apologize for not obeying
your command to stay here.

But... @w(6)I was so worried
and concerned about you...@w(24)
I could not sit idly by.
You belong to my father's troops...

@M(1)They have seized the area
around the Cauldron.

But, his injuries are
severe, and he is in
no shape to do battle.

The precious ring he
received from Your Highness
has been taken away.
You... @w(6)gave away the ring I presented to you...

This was all a part of the
Demon Lord's scheme.@w(6) So,
I was used as a puppet...
I cannot return to my father...

But... I will serve my
responsibility as the king's
daughter and fight.
Please inform the king of my intentions.

You're going to attack alone?
You're asking to be killed.

If I can retrieve that ring,
the entire war will change.

Are you doing this
for your father?

I never imagined
losing someone could
be so terrifying...
I don't want to lose him...

I usually do business
with the Fairies here,

but this area's been
unsafe lately.

I'm lost in this incredible
forest. It must be the Fairy
Forest I've heard about.

For a Valkyrie to come
alone to a place like this...

Let us hear what
she has to say.
Please allow me to introduce myself.

My name is Gwendolyn.
I am King Odin's daughter.

I have been exiled from my
country, but circumstances
forced me to come here.

it was given to me as
a gift. It is extremely
precious to me...
I humbly request that you give me the ring.

You barged in here to ask that?
What cheek!

Do you really expect us to
hand the ring that controls
the Cauldron over to you?
We cannot give you the ring.

This ring is a spoil of war
taken from the Demon Lord.@w(6)
I am its rightful owner now.

I shall be forced to
demonstrate my
Riblam's power.
I told him to get some rest...

'tis even more painful to
be imprisoned by someone@w(6)
for whom you feel nothing.

@M(3)I had the slightest glimmer
of hope in my heart...

Your sword is so close...@w(6)
If you do not reach for it,
my scythe shall claim you.
You have no hope nor power...

You are a shell of a man,
filled with despair...

You belong to my queen,
for all eternity...

Ah, Gwendolyn, 'tis a
relief to find you safe...

Oswald's been depressed
and hasn't touched his food...

When you woke up,
he was so elated...
But to be stolen by a Halja...

Brom has also been injured,
and I don't know what to do.

I'm very worried...
I hear that Brom hasn't
woken up yet.

The Halja has gone
to the Netherworld...
A place the living cannot go.

'Tis impossible for
 you to rescue him.

I know of one person who
is able to make this possible...

You're looking slightly
thinner...@w(6) I've been waiting
for you, Gwendolyn...
I have heard of your exploits.
Assaulting the enemy with just one spear...

Retrieving the ring
from those cunning
and shrewd lasses...

As long as we have the
power to control the Cauldron,
their plans will go awry.

You are the most wonderful
daughter in the cosmos.
You are as precious as that ring.

Now, present your king with
the treasures of victory.

This ring represents a
bond with someone special.@w(6)
I cannot let it go.
The reason I have come today

is to inquire about how
to enter the Netherworld.

What foolishness is this?@w(6)
Give me the ring.

You should know, Father,
since you travel there
to collect crystals.
Will you please hear my request?

Very well. In exchange for
the ring, I shall escort you to
the Netherworld's border.

Not until I make it back
from the Netherworld...
I have poison if you want.

Unfortunately, I do not have
a blade to coat with it...

I will not hand
over my treasure...

Eh? Why didn't you
say you had money...?

My greed is the very
reason I'm down here,
but I do not regret it...

Barging in here without
an invitation... you're as
arrogant as your father.

You, daughter of the petty
thief who steals my jewels,

don't delude yourself
into thinking that you'll
leave here alive.

So you've come running after
your master like a lapdog.

His life has been given to
me in exchange for power.

He walks along the abyss
of eternal death while
serving alongside me.

He was pledged to be mine
before he ever met you.
You are a nuisance to us.
Allow me to personally extinguish your life.
The Valkyrie do not fear death.

And if death cannot
be avoided, then I
welcome my fate.

...But losing Oswald to you is
more painful than death itself.

What do you plan to do with
that spear made from my jewels?

Many souls merge together
to become crystals, then return
to the world above.
You're risking your very soul by playing with that spear.
And now, the time has come to receive your punishment...

Both the living and the dead
could exist in this land

because I bridged the gap
between these two worlds.

Now those that are
still alive will forever be
barred from entering.

The path will close,
and all ties to your world
will be severed.

The only thing that can
overcome death is pure love.

I can no longer collect
crystals from the
Netherworld.

But, if I can regain the
ring and the Cauldron, I
have no need for them.

This is a symbol
of Oswald's love.

Right now, it
represents all I am.

If you take this away, there
